messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 20(5)

Article 20 Presumption of conformity of products within the scope of this Regulation. 5. When preparing the draft implementing act referred to in paragraph 3, the Commission shall take into account the views of relevant bodies or the expert group and shall duly consult all relevant stakeholders.

response.text:
Commission | takeIntoAccount | views of relevant bodies or the expert group | when preparing the draft implementing act referred to in paragraph 3 | the Commission shall take into account the views of relevant bodies or the expert group
Commission | consultStakeholders | all relevant stakeholders | when preparing the draft implementing act referred to in paragraph 3 | shall duly consult all relevant stakeholders
